fact_text: Water is the main solvent in most foods and cooking processes
Salt was one of the earliest and most important food preservation tools
Sugar affects sweetness browning moisture and texture
Gluten-forming proteins in wheat flour help bread trap gas and rise
Baker's yeast produces carbon dioxide during fermentation
Vinegar is produced when microbes convert alcohol into acetic acid
Honey has been used by humans since prehistoric times
Olive oil has been central to Mediterranean cooking for thousands of years
Cornstarch thickens sauces because starch granules swell when heated in water
Gelatin makes heat-reversible gels that melt in the mouth
Pectin helps jams and jellies set into a gel
Xanthan gum is made by microbial fermentation
Guar gum comes from guar beans
Carrageenan comes from red seaweed
Lecithin helps oil and water stay mixed in foods
MSG adds umami flavor by supplying glutamate
Disodium inosinate is often paired with glutamates to boost savory taste
Caffeine is a bitter alkaloid found naturally in coffee tea and cacao
Theobromine is one of cocoa's characteristic methylxanthines
Capsaicin creates a heat sensation by activating heat-sensitive receptors
Piperine is a major pungent compound in black pepper
Curcumin gives turmeric much of its yellow color
Anthocyanins can shift color depending on acidity
Lycopene is a red carotenoid found in tomatoes and watermelon
Beta-carotene gives orange color to carrots and some food colorants
Sodium benzoate is mainly used to inhibit microbes in acidic foods
Potassium sorbate is commonly used to control mold and yeast
Sodium nitrite helps cured meats keep color and resist certain microbes
Sulfur dioxide helps prevent browning and spoilage in some foods
BHA is used to slow fat oxidation in some foods
BHT is an antioxidant preservative used in some fat-containing foods
TBHQ is used to protect oils and fried foods from oxidation
Red 40 is a synthetic red color used in some candies drinks and snacks
Yellow 5 is also known as tartrazine
Blue 1 is also called Brilliant Blue FCF
Annatto is an orange-yellow color from achiote seeds
Turmeric can be used as both a spice and a natural yellow color
Beet pigments can create red or pink food colors
Sucralose is a high-intensity sweetener used at low levels
Aspartame-containing foods may need phenylalanine warnings for people with PKU
Erythritol is a sugar alcohol used in many low-sugar foods
Xylitol is dangerous to dogs even though it is used in human foods
Allulose is a rare sugar used in some low-sugar products
Beta-glucan contributes to the thick texture of oatmeal
Inulin is often extracted from chicory root and used as soluble fiber
Lactic acid is produced during many food fermentations
Malic acid gives apples a tart taste
Tartaric acid is strongly associated with grapes and wine
Sesame can appear as seeds oil paste or tahini
